svg.title: Psychological information in human writing
svg.desc: Frozen linear readouts transfer from profile-conditioned synthetic text to human writing. A, Scores from three v6 models are compared with author self-reports. Real World Worry uses the original cleaned baseline and long texts; the semantic-wellbeing examples use the construct-matched free-text versions, with the same 40 participants contributing both wellbeing endpoints. B, Separate official-test comparisons concern observer judgments of expressed stress and loneliness. Primary layers were fixed before external evaluation: Llama 16, Mistral 24 and Phi 20. Bars are the saved pointwise 95% group-bootstrap intervals, using 200 resamples. Asterisks identify unavailable intervals: the personal-distress data form one connected author/stimulus component, and loneliness authors are unknown. Intervals follow available grouping information. Correlations and ROC AUC remain separate; all primary strata appear in the accompanying data table.
